preconditions.description: Input consists of exactly 5 lines, each representing a blimp registration code.
Each registration code line has at most 11 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.isupper() or c.isdigit() or c == '-' for c in line) for line in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: Each character in a registration code is an uppercase letter, digit, or dash.

postconditions.expression: ('HE GOT AWAY!' in stdout) == (not any('FBI' in line for line in stdin.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: Output is 'HE GOT AWAY!' if and only if no registration code contains the substring 'FBI'.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(num) <= 5 for num in stdout.split()) if 'HE GOT AWAY!' not in stdout else True
postconditions.description: If there are CIA blimps, output contains space-separated integers between 1 and 5 (inclusive), each representing a line number (1-based index) where the registration code contains 'FBI'.

postconditions.expression: sorted([i+1 for i, line in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()) if 'FBI' in line]) == sorted(stdout.split()) if 'HE GOT AWAY!' not in stdout else True
postconditions.description: Output line numbers are sorted in increasing order and correspond exactly to the 1-based indices of lines containing 'FBI'.
